sections.heading: D — Accuracy and verification
sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy and verification

Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 cites exactly one physical page of the private snapshot of the Washington Driver Guide, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: high for the line, lane and zone facts, each restated from an explicit caption or paragraph sentence; nothing was taken from memory, from a non-issuer source, or from the marking pictures themselves.
Precision rule: the median marking width, the shared center lane distance limit, the sharrow passing space and the school zone speed limit are kept exactly as printed inside cited fact blocks in C and C2, with the wording paraphrased so that no learner line copies the guide.
Accuracy flags: the pavement marking pictures on these pages were read only through their caption text, so line drawings and symbols in the images were not read and no fact was taken from them; the emergency zone topic also continues onto the first page of the next section, so its move-over and speed rules are not stated here (verify — sec10-D-FLAG).
Stability: the guide is a single published revision and states it may lag new legislation, so any rule that a future law changes must be re-read from the current edition before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.

corpus_stability.reason: The Washington Driver Guide is one published guide revision (form line 520-400 R/4/25 on physical p4); the guide itself notes it may lag recent legislative changes, and nothing on the selected pages indicates more than one rewrite per year.

verification_debt.claim_text: Pavement marking illustrations (physical pages 130-140) read only via caption text, image content unrepresented; emergency zone move-over/speed rule continues on physical p143 (sec11 range) and is not covered in this section
